data.title: Marina Place
data.about:
Marina Place by Emaar, located in the heart of Rashid Yachts & Marina, redefines waterfront living with its seamless blend of elegance, contemporary design, and world-class amenities. There are two parts of the project, Marina Place 1 and Marina Place 2. Nestled between historic and modern Dubai, these super-luxury residences offer direct access to the marina and easy proximity to Downtown Dubai.

Boasting breathtaking views, both Marina Place 1 & 2 at Rashid Yachts & Marina features 1 to 3-bedroom apartments and exclusive 3-bedroom townhouses, thoughtfully crafted with modern layouts, abundant natural light, and the finest craftsmanship. The project also includes landscaped podiums and inviting spaces designed to bring residents together.

Rashid Yachts & Marina is the ultimate address, particularly for high-net-worth individuals seeking a luxurious lifestyle. With lush green spaces, the boardwalk promenade, and vibrant dining and retail options, residents experience a truly unparalleled way of life at every turn.

characteristics_module.title: Enjoy Serene Luxury By the Water At Marina Place by Emaar
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Exclusive Residences: Marina Place at Mina Rashid Yachts & Marina by Emaar offers luxury 1- to 3-bedroom apartments and 3-bedroom townhouses.
  • Breathtaking Views: Unmatched vistas of the marina, Dubai skyline, and vibrant Arabian Gulf.
  • Marina Lifestyle: Adjacent to a 430-berth marina that accommodates yachts up to 100m, featuring a floating yacht club and 24/7 multilingual marina support.
  • Emaar’s Legacy of Excellence: Developed by Emaar, a trusted name known for delivering iconic landmarks like Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall, ensuring quality and reliability.
  • Vibrant Community Spaces: Designed for interaction and relaxation, Marina Place is located adjacent to the community park and Dubai’s longest swimmable canal pool.
  • Iconic Destination: A part of Rashid Yachts & Marina, Dubai’s new global destination for discerning yacht owners and luxury living enthusiasts.

location_tile.title: An Unparalleled Access to Everything Dubai Has to Offer!
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Marina Place 1 and 2 are ideally located within Rashid Yachts & Marina, one of Dubai’s most prestigious waterfront destinations. The community offers the perfect blend of cultural richness and contemporary convenience. It is an excellent choice for those seeking seamless connectivity to the city’s key landmarks and vibrant lifestyle hubs.

Beyond its central location, Marina Place offers residents proximity to some of Dubai’s most iconic attractions, including the Dubai Mall, Burj Khalifa, and Heritage Village. The development is also adjacent to the longest swimmable canal pool in Dubai and features lush green spaces, a vibrant boardwalk promenade, and a plethora of retail and dining options.

  • 10 Minutes - Sheikh Zayed Road
  • 15 Minutes - Dubai International Airport
  • 20 Minutes - Downtown Dubai
  • 20 Minutes - Dubai Mall/Burj Khalifa
  • 20 Minutes - Dubai Creek Harbour
